programmes.d: AT FIRST SIGHT is the story of a young woman architect who falls in love with a blind man. She encourages him to undergo a radical operation to restore his sight, but ultimately his truest vision comes from the love he finds in his heart.

Autumn in New York follows the sexual exploits of Will Keane (RICHARD GERE) until he runs into an unexpected dead end when he meets Charlotte Fielding (WINONA RYDER). Charlotte is half Will's age and twice his match.

Gloria is a free-spirited, middle-aged divorcee who spends her days at a straight-laced office job and her nights on the dance floor. After meeting Arnold on a night out, she suddenly finds herself thrust into an unexpected new romance.
Elio, a budding teenager, is spending an idyllic summer in Italy with his parents when a handsome research assistant, Oliver, comes to stay with them.

Johnny Saxby works long hours on his family’s farm in the north of England. And when a handsome Romanian migrant worker arrives to take work on the family farm, Johnny suddenly finds himself having to deal with emotions he has never felt before.

Based on a true story, Nitram is an isolated young man living with his parents in Australia until he meets an eccentric heiress. What follows is a gripping portrait of nihilism and violence.

Seduction, passion and power struggles unfold as the creators of Basic Instinct blow the lid off the seemingly glamorous world of Las Vegas showdancing in this controversial film that stars Elizabeth Berkley.

programmes.d: Sergio Leone's final film is the epic tale of the life of a Jewish gangster in New York.
